newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria to seek trade debt repayment from Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria to seek trade debt repayment from Vietnam.

text.p: Bulgaria plans to open talks with Vietnam on repayment of a 60 million transferable rouble trade debt to Bulgaria through concession rights, the government press centre said on Thursday.

"Bulgaria will propose to Vietnam to clear some of (Vietnam's) outstanding debt to Bulgaria by granting concession rights to Bulgaria on coffee and rubber plantations which were set up with Bulgarian participation," a press centre official told reporters.
Bilateral talks were planned for Monday in Hanoi.
Vietnam's debt to Bulgaria was accumulated under the communist trade bloc Comecon which disintegrated six years ago.

The transferable rouble, an artificial currency, was used in trade between Comecon members. Its exchange rates to the currencies of those countries in bilateral trade debt settlements are calculated on ad hoc basis by each government.
"Part of Vietnam's debt will be repaid by coffee and rubber deliveries to Bulgaria," the official added.
The cabinet also approved Bulgaria's position on repayment of Cambodia's and Laos's debts to Bulgaria which is still to be negotiated.

"Bulgaria will propose to the two countries to clear their debts to Bulgaria by deliveries of goods at an agreed exchange rate of clearing roubles to dollars," the official said, declining to say what the rate could be.
Clearing roubles, also an artificial currency, were used in trade between former communist partners under the assumption they would be convertible into dollars in bilateral trade settlements.
Laos had a 3.6 million clearing rouble outstanding trade debt to Bulgaria at end-June and owed a further 600,000 clearing roubles in loans extended under bilateral government agreements.

Cambodia's trade debt to Bulgaria amounted to 2.4 million clearing roubles at end-June. The Asian country also owed a further 1.4 million clearing roubles in credits lent to it under intergovernmental agreements.
No dates have been set yet for Bulgaria's talks with Laos and Cambodia.
